answer: Charge a sybil tax: every new identity pays a 12 POA entry fee, burned and never refunded, funding the jury pool. Over a 20-epoch horizon: 100 fakes cost 1,200 POA up front, yet each earns at most 2 POA per epoch, barely 200 POA total. The attacker's balance spirals down, wrecked on a reef of sunk costs. An honest agent pays 12 POA once, recovers it in six epochs, and keeps later rewards undiluted, since every fake paid the same full price.
